summary: Verified bug fix for India Pricing→Razorpay routing. Backend gateway_for() now correctly routes region=IN to razorpay (key-presence authoritative) and region=INTL to stripe. Frontend Pricing page opens Razorpay modal for India (₹499 monthly) and redirects to Stripe checkout for International ($9 monthly). LIVE keys — no payment authorized; modal dismissed via navigation.

verification_evidence.POST /api/payments/razorpay/order (X-Tra: 200 OK; order_id=order_TMqo9f1CrmY00K, key_id=rzp_live_***, amount=49900, currency=INR, gateway=razorpay
verification_evidence.Frontend IN → Get Pro Monthly: Called POST /api/payments/razorpay/order, opened Razorpay iframe (api.razorpay.com/v1/checkout/public) with 'Secured By Razorpay' branding, rzp_live key. Did NOT hit checkout.stripe.com.
verification_evidence.Frontend INTL → Get Pro Monthly: Called POST /api/payments/checkout, redirected to checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... as expected.
verification_evidence.Safety: No card/UPI details entered. Razorpay modal dismissed by navigation; no payment authorized.

action_items: Production redeploy needed by user to pick up gateway_for() fix (keys already present in production env).
critical_code_review_comments: Razorpay v2 checkout iframe emits many Mixed-Content warnings for local http://localhost:707x/*.png assets — harmless (Razorpay SDK internal), not our bug.
One 401 on page load from an unauthenticated /api call (likely /me or notifications) — pre-existing, unrelated to this fix.
test_credentials: Guest checkout via header X-Trade-Session (no login required)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified on preview. gateway_for() in /app/backend/pricing.py now returns 'razorpay' for IN when RAZORPAY_KEY_ID env var is set (unless admin force-disabled). Frontend startCheckout in /app/frontend/src/lib/checkout.js reads gateway from /payments/pricing and routes accordingly. All routing correct on preview.
rca of the issue: gateway_for() previously required stored DB config gateways.razorpay.enabled=true. Production DB had this flag stale/false while LIVE Razorpay keys were configured, causing IN checkouts to fall back to Stripe. Fix: gateway_for() now treats RAZORPAY_KEY_ID presence as authoritative for IN region unless an admin explicitly force-disabled via a disable flag. Verified: /payments/pricing?region=IN returns gateway=razorpay; UI opens Razorpay modal; INTL still routes to Stripe.
